pr_title: Add support for Flo leak detector pucks
pr_body:

So far the Flo integration only supports shutoff valves. Add support for Flo leak detector pucks, which measure temperature and humidity in addition to providing leak alerts.

Fixes: #43604

issue_context.title: Flo integration: unable to setup switch due to missing lastKnown valve state
issue_context.body:
## The problem
I have setup the Flo integration. I have one home configured with with the Flo app. It has one Smart Water Shutoff Valve and a number of Smart Water Detectors. The valve device comes up with a number of entities (current mode, pending system alerts, todays water usage, water flow rate, water pressure, and water temperature). All of these values appear to be correct (the temperature might be wrong, but I believe that is a regression in the API Flo provides). However the problem is the switch entity is missing. Below is the traceback from the logs when the code is trying to configure the switch.


## Environment
Home Assistant 0.118.3
Frontend version: 20201111.2
Host Operating System | HassOS 5.4
Update Channel | stable
Supervisor Version | 2020.11.0

Device info: flo_device_075_v2 Firmware: 6.1.1

- Integration causing this issue: flo
- Link to integration documentation on our website: 
https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/flo/


## Traceback/Error logs

```
Logger: homeassistant.components.switch
Source: components/flo/device.py:168
Integration: Switch (documentation, issues)
First occurred: 10:55:16 AM (1 occurrences)
Last logged: 10:55:16 AM

Error while setting up flo platform for switch
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity_platform.py", line 199, in _async_setup_platform
    await asyncio.shield(task)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/flo/switch.py", line 29, in async_setup_entry
    async_add_entities([FloSwitch(device) for device in devices])
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/flo/switch.py", line 29, in <listcomp>
    async_add_entities([FloSwitch(device) for device in devices])
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/flo/switch.py", line 60, in __init__
    self._state = self._device.last_known_valve_state == "open"
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/flo/device.py", line 168, in last_known_valve_state
    return self._device_information["valve"]["lastKnown"]
KeyError: 'lastKnown'
```

@dmulcahey I have done a bit of debugging.

I have a few of the Smart Water Detectors. I did some investigation and noticed that the failures were caused by the deviceModel type puck_v1. So I filtered out all of the non primary flo devices and it all works. I suspect this is not how you'd want to do this, but I wanted to make note here that it worked.

```
diff --git a/homeassistant/components/flo/__init__.py b/homeassistant/components/flo/__init__.py
index b57cdd5..dbaf124 100644
--- a/homeassistant/components/flo/__init__.py
+++ b/homeassistant/components/flo/__init__.py
@@ -49,6 +49,12 @@ async def async_setup_entry(hass: HomeAssistant, entry: ConfigEntry):
     tasks = [device.async_refresh() for device in devices]
     await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
 
+    for device in hass.data[DOMAIN][entry.entry_id]["devices"][:]:
+        print(device.id)
+        if device.model != "flo_device_075_v2":
+            print(device.id)
+            hass.data[DOMAIN][entry.entry_id]["devices"].remove(device)
+
     for component in PLATFORMS:
         hass.async_create_task(
             hass.config_entries.async_forward_entry_setup(entry, component)
```
Whoops I completely missed this. I’ll see if I can peek at this this week.

review_comments: Leak detector pucks measure *air* temperature, not water temperature. `FloTemperatureSensor` has been updated to handle both.
Usually you'll have multiple leak detectors, so using the device nickname is important to get sensible device names.
so I think I did this originally because HA will auto adjust it based on what the user configures. I need to go through the old PR's to see if this was something I was asked to do.
nope... this is something I should have done myself... :( https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/38171#discussion_r467460761
Flo pucks are passive detectors and have no switch capabilities.
